content.text: The Office of Student Experience conducted its first townhall of 2023 for students of AKU's Medical College, School of Nursing and Midwifery, and Institute of Educational Development with over 300 students were in attendance. Dr. Laila Akbarali, Interim Vice Provost - Student Affairs and Services and University Registrar, conducted the townhall and introduced the
. Danish Imtiaz, Associate Director, Student Experience, gave an overview of the program along with the eligibility criteria.

The Registrar's office addressed the updated policy on outstanding accounts with the university along with the launch of the online facilitation system for student services. Students were invited to voice their questions and concerns as the townhall wrapped up with a promise to conduct more in the future.
